text:
raj singh: Heads-up — UK bank POC wants a full compliance bundle before we kick off dedicated infra. They specifically asked for: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert, and a signed pen-test letter. timeline is tight (targeting next Wed). Can we pull these together?

anne lee: Ack. Which environment are they expecting access to for the POC — hosted API or dedicated? That changes the artifact list and any extra network diagrams.

mike o'neil: They mentioned "dedicated pool (reserved) with private peering" in the legal thread. i'll double-check with procurement, but assume Dedicated.

raj singh: Yes dedicated. Also customer asked if pen-test letter can be signed by a third-party or if an internal attestation is OK. They're quite strict on third-party.

nina patel: Quick answers: SOC2 report + ISO cert: we can provide redacted copies (standard). Third-party pen-test letter: we have a 3rd-party pen-test summary and an internal attestation. Full vendor-signed pen-test letter requires coordination with the vendor and legal (~5-7 business days). We can provide our internal signed attestation same-day.

anne lee: Can you paste the minimal artifact checklist we should send to the customer? i want to include it in the package.

nina patel: Paste below — go ahead to send as-is.
```
Required POC compliance bundle (redacted where appropriate):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period)
- ISO 27001 certificate + scope statement
- Pen-test attestation (internal) + vulnerability summary
- Network topology diagram for Dedicated deployment (redacted egress IPs)
- Data handling & retention summary (POC scope)
- SSO/SAML support statement + sample SAML metadata
- Contact for escalations (security@redwood.com)
```

mike o'neil: Pricing question from the buyer: if we run a 2-week dedicated POC, do we bill at dedicated reserved rates or offer a short-term trial discount? finance/solutions: thoughts?

anne lee: For enterprise POCs we typically offer a time-limited promo credit and reserve capacity with a month-to-month price. i'll loop in pricing but we can specify that long-term dedicated commitments revert to reserved pricing.

raj singh: Customer also asked for "evidence of no-data-retention of keys in transit" and KMS usage notes. nina, can we include a short KMS/keys statement?

nina patel: Yes — we'll give a 3-paragraph KMS statement (what we store, envelope encryption, HSM/KMS integration, rotation cadence). I'll attach a short sample.

ops-bot (evidence-bot): Automated: Compliance artifact bundle template created: //drive/redwood/compliance/templates/pocevidence_v2.zip (access: sales@redwood.com).

raj singh: Perfect, thanks. Nina — if we can provide the internal attestation today and the SOC2/ISO redacted PDFs, i'll send to the buyer and note third-party pen-test timing. Also need staging creds + short runbook (no production data).

nina patel: I'll upload the attestation and KMS note to the drive link in 2 hours. SOC2/ISO PDFs are in place, redacted.

mike o'neil: I'll draft a short pricing note: 2-week Dedicated POC = one-off month of reserved pricing with $x promo credit. will confirm numbers by EOD.

anne lee: Action items: 
- nina: upload attestation + KMS statement to drive (ETA 2h)
- mike: confirm POC pricing note (ETA EOD)
- raj: send evidence bundle to buyer once artifacts up, mention third-party pen-test ETA 5-7bd

raj singh: Sounds good. tagging @nina patel and @mike o'neil. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
